id.description: Stable community plugin id. Must match the catalog entry id.

name.description: Human-readable plugin name shown by TFS.

version.description: Package version. Must match the catalog entry version.

description.description: Optional short plugin description shown by the runtime loader.

sdkVersion.description: Tools for Steam Plugin SDK version. SDK v1 manifests use major version 1.

entryPoint.description: Relative JavaScript entry point inside the package.

permissions.description: Declared SDK capabilities. Known v1 permissions are frontend, storage, secrets, and network.
